fullDesc: Epic Games launched Fortnite Battle Royale as a free mode in September 2017. It grew to hundreds of millions of players and hosted live in-game concerts, including one by Travis Scott in 2020.
realFacts: Epic Games turned it into a huge business
Travis Scott's 2020 concert drew over 12 million live players
Epic sued Apple in 2020 over app store fees
It popularised the battle royale genre
